name: sandclaude-editor
description: Self-contained CodeMirror 6 bundle for the sandclaude dashboard (no-build vanilla frontend).
comment: Dependencies are pinned to exact versions (no ^) on purpose: the built bundle is committed and go:embed-ed into the host binary, so it runs as trusted host-side code in the dashboard browser. Exact pins keep the bundle reproducible and prevent a stray npm install from pulling an unreviewed release. Update versions deliberately, then rebuild and review the bundle diff.
